text: Every buyer needs technology. A CIO in Riyadh. A retailer in Nairobi. A founder in Bengaluru. But the market is fragmented.
Enter Cloud Quarks, by Redington. It orchestrates it all, from one core. One platform. One identity. One data model.
C Q C, Commerce, is live today. It quotes, provisions, bills, reconciles and governs every order, as a running service.
C Q M, the Marketplace, sells. Know what you want? Go to the catalogue. Not sure? Start at RACE, Redington's A I Centre of Excellence.
Then, four moves. A catalogue that powers A I search. Rules for tax and pricing, by geography. A store for every market, spun up, not rebuilt. And every model, from direct to white label.
Underneath, C Q A, Analytics, learns. Forecasting, renewal risk, partner performance, and margin integrity.
One core. Two branches. One intelligence layer. That's Cloud Quarks.
